'''Cryogenic capacitors''' were similar in design to [[cryogenic cell]]s, and were used as reserve [[Power cell/Legends|power cells]] in [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] such as the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]]. The capacitors were located in the fighter's [[S-foils/Legends|S-foils]] and stored additional power for the [[Engine/Legends|engines]].<ref name="SWS" />
